primary_endpoint: Percentage change from baseline in liver fat content assessed by MRI-PDFF at day 61.
efficacy_outcome: At day 61, liver fat change was -26.8% with HU6 150 mg, -35.6% with 300 mg, and -33.0% with 450 mg, versus +5.4% with placebo; statistical significance was not reported.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths were reported: 0/20, 0/21, and 0/19 with HU6 150, 300, and 450 mg, respectively, and 0/20 with placebo.
